content.text:
Re-review only; no files edited. I accepted the stated fresh MSBuild result and did not repeat the prior brace claim.

- ADDRESSED — Unique import key/caption. `ImportDetailID` is the sole visible import key with caption `ID chi tiết`; the underlying `DeviceCheckingDetailID` is hidden and renamed `ID nội bộ`. The form imports using `ID chi tiết` and validates `ImportDetailID` against the internal ID. (`08...sql:47-49, 99-160`; `frmDeviceChecking.cs:1374-1394`)
- ADDRESSED — Completion blocks unsaved edits. The handler closes the active editor, updates the current row, checks all `IsEdit` values, and exits before confirmation/store execution when changes remain. (`frmDeviceChecking.cs:1410-1443`)
- ADDRESSED — Freeze/save/complete concurrency locking. Freeze and complete take `UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK` on the parent row before status validation and retain it through their transactions. Save performs its actual update through a join that takes the same parent-row lock and rechecks the allowed status in the update predicate, preventing a save from succeeding after completion. (`03...sql:35-42`; `05...sql:81-103`; `06...sql:57-61`)
- NOT ADDRESSED — Transaction ownership / double rollback. `SaveData()` owns the outer transaction and rolls it back in its catch (`frmDeviceChecking.cs:1173-1210`), but `SaveDetail()` uses inherited `ExecNonQuery()`, whose catch also calls `RollBackTransaction()` whenever a shared `IDB` is attached (`FAM_DeviceBase.cs:1049-1065`). Thus a failed detail save rolls back and disconnects inside the item, then the form attempts to roll back that same transaction again.
- ADDRESSED — Deployment key allocation. Patches 07 and 08 allocate `GridColumnID` inside explicit transactions and acquire `UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK` while reading `MAX(GridColumnID)`, serializing concurrent allocators that follow these patches. (`07...sql:6-11, 116`; `08...sql:107-112, 152`)
- ADDRESSED — Documented implemented workflow. README explicitly documents the implemented `1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 5` flow, Excel preview/save process, incomplete-row completion restriction, and completed-record lock. (`README.txt:18-25, 31-40`)

New critical regression introduced by the fixes: none found in the inspected scope.
